note: echo reads one serial manager and writes what it gets to another. The rows loop the console onto itself (${CONSOLE} ${CONSOLE}), which needs no hardware. echo stops 10 s after it starts if nothing comes, or 5 s after the last character.

tests.note: a failed input manager must not leave the output one reserved: it used to stay held by the console until a reset, and every other writer - a cycle process - then blocked forever (fixed, ../DEFECTS.md). Fails on images built before the fix. Only _T is refuted: on a multi-core image (MAiXDUiNO_K210) the idle console of the other core holds its own _R while it waits for a line; board-regression's health check still catches an _R left on the console's core
the text comes back, then echo ends 5 s later - and writes nothing more. Before fix/echo-trailing-nul it wrote the zeroed read buffer after the timeout: one NUL byte
nothing is typed: echo must give the console back after its 10 s first-character timeout
